title: Foreman-B Worker Pool
description: Foreman-B coordinates workers 021-040 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 021-040 are grouped into five lanes. Pool summaries report lane counts and shared-lock status.

messages.systemLog: Assign work: Foreman-B splits Packet B across five lanes for workers 021-040.

messages.text: Pool B update: 16 workers are placing blocks, 4 are waiting on Gate A, and there are zero writes against the locked seam.

messages.systemLog: Receive message: Pool B reports active workers, waiting workers, placed blocks, and locked-seam status.

messages.text: worker-027 reports a blocked path in lane 3. I am routing that lane around temporary scaffolding instead of pausing the entire pool.

messages.systemLog: Exception report: worker-027 reports a blocked path and reroutes lane 3 around temporary scaffolding.

messages.text: Pool B complete. The one blocked lane was rerouted, all lanes are aligned, and the diff is ready for the next gate.

messages.systemLog: Receive message: Foreman-B completes Packet B and submits the aligned diff.
